note: Neutral learner-action vocabulary. Describes what the learner is asked to DO, never which native component or page object realises it. Print may satisfy an action on paper; Learn may satisfy it interactively. An action with requires_response=false is satisfied by passive content.

order-items.label: Put items in order
order-items.learner_does: Arrange a set of distinct items into a defensible order.

complete-missing-values.label: Complete what is missing
complete-missing-values.learner_does: Supply the missing words, terms or values inside a given structure.
complete-missing-values.response_shape: one value per declared gap identifier

select-one.label: Choose one
select-one.learner_does: Choose exactly one option from a closed set.

select-many.label: Choose all that apply
select-many.learner_does: Choose every option that satisfies the prompt from a closed set.

match-pairs.label: Match the pairs
match-pairs.learner_does: Connect each item on one side to its counterpart on the other.
match-pairs.response_shape: set of source-identifier to target-identifier links
match-pairs.cardinality: each source used at most once

classify-items.label: Sort into categories
classify-items.learner_does: Assign each item to a named category using a membership rule.
classify-items.response_shape: set of item-identifier to category-identifier assignments
classify-items.cardinality: declared per capability as one or multiple categories per item

enter-number.label: Give a numeric answer
enter-number.learner_does: Produce a numeric value, optionally with a unit.

enter-text.label: Answer in words
enter-text.learner_does: Produce a short written answer in the learner's own words.
enter-text.note: Automatic scoring is only legitimate against a declared accepted-answer set. Open reasoning is teacher-reviewed.

identify-region.label: Point to the right place
identify-region.learner_does: Identify the correct region of a given visual.

place-labels.label: Place the labels
place-labels.learner_does: Attach each label to its correct target on a given visual.
place-labels.response_shape: set of label-identifier to target-identifier links
place-labels.cardinality: each label placed at most once

compare-without-response.label: Study the comparison
compare-without-response.learner_does: Read and compare presented material without producing a response.

read-explanation.label: Read the explanation
read-explanation.learner_does: Read presented exposition without producing a response.

produce-extended-response.label: Write an extended answer
produce-extended-response.learner_does: Produce reasoning, justification or working that a teacher judges.
produce-extended-response.note: Never auto-scored. Requires teacher review or a rubric.
